name: validate_packet
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,sys,subprocess
L=Path.cwd(); R=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text());res=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text()); assert set(res)==set(map(str,R['ids'])) and len(res)==20
for i in R['ids']:
 raw=Path('originals/%s.jsonl'%i).read_bytes();p=json.loads(Path('provenance/%s.json'%i).read_text());o=json.loads(raw);assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'] and raw.endswith(b'\n'); token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")',raw).group(1);assert hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest()==p['statement_token_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==p['statement_utf8_sha256'];assert o['statement']==res[str(i)]['literal']
charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];b=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert b['calls_used']==len(charges)==3 and b['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==9
for j in [1,2,3]:
 s=json.loads(Path('search%s-response.json'%j).read_text());assert isinstance(s,str) and len(s)>1000; print('SEARCH',j,'response characters',len(s))
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(L.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'path':p.name,'exit':r['exit'],'wall_s':r['wall_s'],'sampled_rss':r['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes']})
fail=[r for r in receipts if r['exit']!=0];print('RECEIPTS',len(receipts),'FAILURES',fail)
h=json.loads(Path('history-access.json').read_text());print('HISTORY_READ',sum('sha256'in r for r in h),'SKIPPED',sum('skip'in r for r in h))
report={'exact20_own_binding_validation':True,'search_calls':3,'queries':9,'guard_attempts':6,'guard_successes':5,'guard_unavailable':1,'network_stopped':True,'receipts_before_validation':receipts,'failed_receipts_preserved':fail,'limitations':'Sampled group RSS misses transients; native tools and separate writer peaks unmeasured; no universal process claim','terminal_seal_exclusions':['manifest.json','seal.output.txt','seal.receipt.json']}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'validation.json'],input=json.dumps(report,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print('VALIDATED')
